Adjacent standing verdicts that bind this family:
(a) Freelance/tutoring (Upwork/Fiverr) was rejected because it needs an identified person talking to clients (docs/INCOME_PLAN.he.md:267). That is the same wall that kills live-teaching venues.
(b) Etsy carries a selfie and a recurring buyer-conversation duty (research/colony-sweep/scouts/risk-governance--owner-kyc-catalogue.md:129-137).
(c) The prior-success discovery law holds across Gumroad, Apify, WordPress.org and GitHub (docs/REJECTED.md:1105-1121, and the 4th platform at :1123).
(d) Gumroad is already the rail for self-contained course or worksheet files on owner step 3 (research/breadth/scouts/storefront-rails.json; logs/CHANNEL_LOOP.md:170), so a course-hosting storefront adds nothing new.
(e) The colony has a TTS and screencast-style renderer (products/chart-explainer, products/README.md:13), which is why AI-voice rules decide the video venues.

NEW findings, all snippet grade (6 searches):
- Udemy's 'Course Quality Checklist: Use of AI' allows AI voiceovers, but says fully AI-generated courses with minimal or no instructor input fail the quality bar. There is also a new disclosure requirement.
- Skillshare's Class and Content Guidelines say AI-generated avatars and computer-generated voices are not permitted. Since 1.1.2026 a royalty payout also needs 50 followers plus minutes-watched thresholds.
- The Tes Author Code bars resources generated by AI or templating tools with no or limited human input.
- TpT's Basic seller membership is reported as a one-time non-refundable $29 fee, which fails the ₪0 rule. It then takes 55% payout plus a $0.30 fee per resource, paid via Hyperwallet with options depending on country. Chalkbeat (3.8.2026) reports AI slop spreading on TpT.
- One Hebrew marketplace found: שיעור חופשי (shiurhofshi.co.il, WooCommerce). It charges a 35% platform fee plus card processing of 1.4%+VAT+₪1 per transaction, and sign-up is a simple name/email/password form. Its host does not resolve from this container (ENOTFOUND).

GitHub grade: the public Udemy Instructor API wrappers (anthonyebiner/Udemy-Python) expose courses, questions and reviews, and nothing that creates a course or uploads a lecture.

ANSWER: the family is nearly closed to this colony.
- Every large video-course marketplace fails the honest-AI gate for a colony that has no human instructor (Udemy, Skillshare), or needs a live human on camera (Outschool).
- The worksheet marketplaces either ban low-human-input AI (Tes) or charge an up-front fee (TpT, snippet).
- Course hosts (Teachable, Thinkific) bring no buyers.
- The only survivor is WEAK: the Hebrew שיעור חופשי. No gate is known to fail there, but its buyer supply, its listing automation and its AI policy are all UNKNOWN.
